3M likes, 23K comments - cbum on September 22, 2026: "Jacked and athletic. Slowly bridging the gap.

Apparently a 60 inch box jump was too easy of a goal. Now I need to be able to do it without the run-up.

Honestly it’s just fun to be able to express some of my training in different ways to see how I’m improving. Still a long way to go, but I’m proud of the progress.🤝".
